limitations: Laver tables only for t <= 8 (A_2) and t <= 5 (A_3).
statement: The Laver tables A_2 and A_3 give automata whose light cones depend on at most 3 resp. 4 cells (t <= 8 resp. 5) with widths 4 and 8; GF(4) multiplication and XOR on [0,4) have width 4; the anchored golden- and odd-law models of C06 are permutive (hence surjective) affine automata.
title: Earlier structures of the lab as automata
